item.title: Hubble 1.1.2
item.description:
Hubble 1.1.2
Hubble 1.1.2: Fix Companion plugin installation
Fix automatic setup when Companion's Developer Modules Path starts with ~/, including cases where the Hubble module is already installed but does not appear in Companion. Hubble now saves the full folder path, backs up the original settings, and preserves custom folders and unrelated Companion settings.
After updating, run Install in Companion again and approve the Companion restart when prompted. Setup installs the module and creates or verifies the Hubble connection.
